data.summary: The reviews present a mixed and incomplete picture. The 1-star complaint is highly specific and credible. The 5-star reviews lack detail; one is clearly from an employee, which is not a genuine customer experience. The extremely low review count for a pool contractor is unusual and a red flag. There is not enough authentic customer content to form a reliable assessment of service quality.
fake_signals: One review is from an employee, not a customer
Very low review volume (6) for a pool contractor
No detailed project reviews from customers
authentic_signals: Specific complaint details (stop sign, red light)
One review mentions a specific warranty repair
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp, but the low volume of reviews makes it difficult to assess true consistency.
